site: MOXIR hall, Charentsavan. Owner's pin 40.406524, 44.636560 (inside span 3).
layer: Layered AFTER moxir-hall-dims-2026-09-28.json, moxir-hall-features-2026-09-28.json and the crane-dj file. Corrections from the owner's check of the photographs ("from left columns there are not 5 closed walls, only 2") and two researchers' reading of all 36 photos, the Soviet standards and OSM (session scratchpad hall-photos/, hall-standards/).
frame: x along hall, y across, z up from floor; metres. Same frame as the 09-28 layer.

low_walls.seen: photos 004, 009 (from the entry-end crane): the block wall runs from the first big Y column in view to the third, 2 bays, then the row is open; also 003, 005, 006, 013, 008, 033/034. Photo 032 has a white shed hiding the bay before the first column. The bays are decided by a render from the 004/009 viewpoint (camera 0, 7.8, 53, looking down the hall, vfov 47): [24, 36] (grid z 30.5 to 18.5) puts the wall's start at the first big column and its end at the third, as in the photo; [12, 24] and [18, 30] do not.

confidence.truss_bottom_h_m: medium: the Soviet height series for such halls is 8.4 / 9.6 / 10.8 / 12.0 m floor to roof underside; 10.8 is the series value next to the earlier photo fit of 11.0 (+-0.4)
confidence.truss_top_h_m: medium: bottom chord + the 2.5 m space-frame depth kept
confidence.ridge_h_m: low-medium: the lantern top = deck + lantern height, 13.3 + 3.2
confidence.lantern_h_m: medium: the standard lantern for a 24 m span is 2.77 or 3.22 m overall (standards notes e.txt); 3.2 taken
confidence.low_walls: medium: the left row from the render match to photos 004/009 (2 bays); the right row is open everywhere (003, 005, 006, 009, 027) and has no wall
confidence.crane_cab_side: medium-high: the orange cab hangs at the +x end in photos 002, 003, 004, 005, 009, 013
confidence.runway_handrail_rows: medium: the left runway is a plate girder WITH a handrail (004, 009); the right one is a darker box girder with ladders and heavy duct pipes and NO handrail (009, 004)

notes: 2026-10-02 hall corrections, each with its source: (1) the LEFT low wall is 2 closed bays, not 5 (the 09-28 features file said bays 3-7 from photo 032, wrong): from_door_m [24, 36]. (2) the RIGHT low wall (a GUESS in the 09-28 file, [60, 84]) is deleted: the right row is open (003, 005, 006, 009, 027: machinery and pipes between the columns). (3) the crane cab hangs at the RIGHT (+x) end (002, 003, 004, 005, 009, 013), x 8.35-10.35 in the nave crane's frame. (4) the roof underside 11.0 -> 10.8 m (Soviet height series 8.4 / 9.6 / 10.8 / 12.0) and the top chord 13.5 -> 13.3 (2.5 m depth kept). (5) the lantern 3.5 -> 3.2 m (standard lantern for a 24 m span: 2.77 or 3.22 m). (6) the right runway girder has no handrail; the left one keeps it.

Left unchanged on purpose: the crane rail (7.6 m in this layer set; the standards give 7.75 for 16-20 t or 8.15 for <= 10 t cranes and the crane's capacity is unknown, so measure on site); the 6 x 6 x 2.5 m space frame (photo-derived; it is NOT the 'Kislovodsk' series, which is 3 x 3 x 2.12 m for low buildings); the expansion joint (the lantern gap is the evidence); the floor-rail gauge (unmeasured).

sources.standards: hall-standards/e.txt (Soviet height series, lantern sizes, crane rail heights by capacity)
